title: ReviewCounts

toolCalls.description: Tool calls decided in the run (one tool.decision each).

autoApproved.description: Calls allowed with no person answering: by the mode, a rule or a classifier.

answeredByPerson.description: Calls a person decided through a prompt, allowed or denied.

expired.description: Calls whose prompt was denied past its TTL.

description: A reviewed run's tool calls: how many, auto-approved, denied, answered by a person, expired.
